capabilities.description: Track stock levels across locations, manage SKUs, and automate reorder points to prevent stockouts and overstock.
Process sales transactions, manage orders, returns, and exchanges across in-store and online channels.
Maintain customer profiles, purchase history, and segment customers for targeted marketing and loyalty programs.
Provide real-time dashboards and reports on sales, inventory turnover, and store performance for data-driven decisions.
Manage supplier relationships, purchase orders, and lead times, with automated reorder suggestions based on demand.
Connect physical stores, e-commerce platforms, and marketplaces for unified inventory and order management.
Ensure regulatory compliance with audit trails, data privacy, and secure transaction logging.

summary: RetailOS is a modern retail operations platform that unifies inventory, sales, customers, and analytics for small to mid-sized retail businesses and multi-store operators. It provides real-time visibility into stock levels, automated replenishment recommendations, customer insights, and performance dashboards, all in a single cloud-based system.
